figures.item: Capital gains tax on shares of companies that indirectly (through other companies) hold Cyprus immovable property: from the 2026 reform such shares count as property if at least this share of their market value derives from Cyprus property (previously 50%); a double tax treaty requiring 50% overrides
figures.quote: τουλάχιστον το 20% (αντί του 50%) της αγοραίας αξίας

figures.item: CGT exemption for disposals of shares listed on a NON-regulated market of a recognised stock exchange: applies only if total disposals in the year do not exceed this; once exceeded, CGT is due on ALL the year's disposals (a cliff). Shares on a regulated market stay fully exempt.
figures.quote: δεν υπερβαίνει σωρευτικά τις €50.000

figures.item: CGT exemption on disposal of a main residence in loan restructuring, bankruptcy, insolvency or foreclosure: value limit raised to this from EUR 350,000. NOT the general main-residence lifetime exemption.
